mapper.insert: INSERT INTO expense_records (family_group_id, payment_account_id, author_member_id, amount, note, occurred_at, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{familyGroupId}, #{paymentAccountId}, #{authorMemberId}, #{amount}, #{note}, #{occurredAt}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM expense_records WHERE payment_account_id = #{paymentAccountId}
mapper.update: UPDATE expense_records SET locked_by_member_id = NULL, locked_at = NULL WHERE id = #{id}
